title: Driving the teleprompter from a remote
description: Start, stop and going back are available without touching the screen.

blocks.text: During a performance the hands may be busy. Familiar actions on the remote matter more than a large set of modes on the phone.

quote.text: the Scroll up and down functions on a presentation remote (like podcaster) no longer works with this app. So I bit the bullet and got another teleprompter app for $90/year.

blocks.text: Let the supported buttons be assigned and tested at a rehearsal. Keep the device profile and show the state of the connection.
Check reconnection and the behavior after a pause. A lost connection has to be noticeable before the next press on stage.
